read-together.name: Read together
read-together.scene:
A thick picture book stands half open on its spine, its cream pages fanned, with a soft sky and a small hill painted on them.
A plush bunny in dusty lavender sits leaning against the book, as if it is listening, and two more small books lie stacked beside it.
A tiny reading lamp in ochre clay bends over the pages and casts a warm pool of light.
The mood is the quiet, close calm of a bedtime story.

bath-time.name: Bath time
bath-time.scene:
A small, round-bellied clawfoot bathtub in cream clay is filled to the brim with soft felt bubbles that spill over one edge.
An ochre felt fish toy bobs among the bubbles, and three little stacking cups in sage, coral and lavender sit on the rim, the top one tipping a short ribbon of water back into the tub.
The mood is warm, splashy and playful.

cook-together.name: Cook together
cook-together.scene:
A wide mixing bowl in terracotta clay holds a soft heap of batter with a wooden whisk resting in it.
Beside it lie two halves of a cracked eggshell, a small mound of flour with a tiny scoop, and three short carrots with felt leaves.
A small sage felt apron lies folded next to the bowl, child-sized.
The mood is a happy, slightly messy kitchen helper moment.

let-them-lead.name: Let them lead
let-them-lead.scene:
A crooked tower of mismatched wooden blocks in sage, ochre and coral, built the way a toddler builds it, with a small felt giraffe toy proudly placed on top.
A few blocks lie scattered where they were chosen and left.
A round felt cushion sits a little way back, facing the tower, as if a grown-up is sitting there just watching.
The mood is calm and unhurried: the child is in charge.
